answer: Layered vesting makes sybil profit trapped capital. Each epoch rewards credit to a vesting knoll of unwithdrawable earnings; one twentieth unlocks per epoch of verified work, so a fresh identity needs twenty epochs. When the mirror ledger spots coordination in the attestation graph, it freezes linked accounts and forfeits unvested piles to the treasury. Running K identities forces the attacker to float K times the standard reward for twenty idle epochs; early exit donates that float to honest agents. The opal of the scheme, instant profit, never materializes for sybils.
